workspaces.description: Autopsy 4.23.1 and The Sleuth Kit 4.15.0 in an isolated Kasm environment for disk image analysis.
workspaces.notes: Mount the evidence in /evidence as read-only and the Autopsy folders in /cases as read-write. This workspace does not require privileged mode, raw devices, or a Docker socket.

workspaces.description: Launch n8n in an isolated, disposable Kasm Chrome session to create cyber, DevOps, and AI automations.
workspaces.notes: n8n listens only on 127.0.0.1 within the container. Create the owner account on first launch. Workflows, credentials, and runs are deleted when Kasm terminates the session.

workspaces.description: Launch Instant Velociraptor in an isolated, temporary Kasm session.
workspaces.notes: Velociraptor Instant Mode: admin/password. The server listens only within the container, and the data is deleted when the session ends.
